tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa lam glu dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥ sarba gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa bhyaḥ phyi ltar na phyogs med kyi bandhe/ nang ltar na gsang chen gyi sngags 'chang / gsang ba ltar na rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rings kun spangs pa zhes yongs su grags pa de'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang / chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i ngang du ro gcig kyang / chos can gdangs 'gag med kyi rol rtsed tha dad du shar ba/ rje de nyid kyi zhabs kyi padmo gtsug gis bsten cing / bka' drin chen pos 'tsho ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bka' 'bangs rigs sngags 'chang ba'i bande blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ da lta ming yongs su grags pa tshar pa chos rje/ don la ci med kyi bhu su ku/ yul phyogs med du rgyu ba'i sprang po yan pa blo bde zhes bya ba des yul 'dar stod mang mkhar gyi pho brang du skye ba med pa la skye ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/ grum stod kha'u'i brag la sgom rgyu rdul tsam med pa la sgom pa'i ro myangs/ rgyal khams phyogs med kyi bzhi mdor rang don gyi dgos pa ci yang med bzhin du nyin mtshan yad yud du 'gro ba'i dgos don mang po spyod cing gnas pa las/ bye brag tu rang lo sum cu so brgyad yan la/ yul dbus kyi sman ljongs su lan gsum phyin pa'i dang po/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa rje ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs phyir 'brengs te phyin nas lo brgyad tsam bsdad/ bar pa la sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag spa ra bas gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i gser sku bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la phyin nas zla ba drug tsam bsdad de mgyogs bskor byas/ de dag gi lo rgyus rnams bshad na/ dga' ba la bsams na nam langs pa 'dra ba/ skyo ba la bsams na sa rub pa 'dra ba/ btang snyoms pa byang thang skya mo la gar byed pa 'dra ba ji snyed cig yod pa labs kyang sprang po'i glu la nyan mkhan med pas dgos pa chung bas rgyab tu bskyur la zhog

/lan gsum pa rang lo so brgyad pa'i dus su phyin nas lo gnyis tsam bsdad dus kyi 'phros gtam/ yas phyin gyi lam du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gyi rtogs brjod lam glu dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dga' ston ku mud gsar pa kha bye ba 'dra ba 'di nyid/ smras pa la ched du dgos pa chen po mi 'dug ste/ gsang dgos pa'i mtshang yang med pas/ snang ba gdong 'ded gzhir bzhag la/ da lam lab pa ngos 'di snang ba la shar byung bas gsan pa zhu zhig de yang / de gong phyin dus grwa rigs sbyin bdag so sor yong ba'i khas len yang byas yod pa dang / rjes su rim par nan tan gyi 'bod mi 'phral du byung ba dang / 'dul bar 'os pa'i snod ldan gyi gdul bya 'ga' zhig kyang 'dul dus la babs 'dug cing / rang nyid kyang yul phyogs med kyi bdud rtsi bsten na nang du sems nyid la 'gyur ba chen po zhig 'ong shas che bas/ de snga phyin pa'i dus sbyin bdag gi rta drel gyis skyel bsu byas pa'i tshe/ rta rdzi drel rdzi mi ngan bsam pa chung zhing ltogs 'dod che ba rnams kyi ngo mi zin bzhin du 'dzin dgos pa de zhe sun la skabs su mi bab pa zhig 'ong gin 'dug pa dang / khyad par lam bar rnams su yang sngar chos 'brel yod pa dang / da chos zhu 'dod kyi bla ma mjal ba/ gnas bzang po dang rten khyad par can mjal ba sogs/ dgos don thams cad blos btang nas/ bde gzar chen po 'khrug kha ma'i gser yig pa bzhin du nam langs sa rub drel khal gyi rjes la/ lam gzhung bsrangs nas thal mar rgyug dgos pa de ye yid la mi 'bab pa zhig byung bas/ bya bral 'gros kyi 'gro bar brtsams te phag gi lo hor zla lnga pa'i dus/ sa gzhi rnams margad gsar pas byugs pa ltar rtswa sngon gyis sngo 'jam du gyur cing / ind+ra nī la'i rgya mtsho glo bur du rdol ba ltar chu bo dang chu phran mtha' dag rab tu rgyas shing / rlabs phreng gis mdzes pa'i lbu ba'i 'dzum dkar phyogs brgyar rgod pa/

skye bo rnams dpyid kyi dus ston bzang po la babs pas dga' zhing chags pa'i rnam 'gyur shas cher ston pa'i ri klung kun khyab par glu dbyangs dang rgod sgra 'brel mar rgyu ba'i tshe/ gdan 'dren gyi pho nya dang bcas pa'i nged dpon slob lnga phrag gsum tsam yod pa thams cad ha cang rgan pa dang gzhon pa ma yin par lang tsho dar la bab pa/ dge sbyong la 'os pa'i cha lugs ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan zhe gcig pa/ ched du spong ba lhur len pa'i mtshon byed ras dkar gyi cog bu gangs ri'i dum bu chad pa 'dra ba re dang / sba dbyug dkar po dung gi tshugs shing lta bu re/ bsam gtan gyi 'bol chung kha gang ma grwa zur ma nyams pa re/ grwa chung dang gra phad zur gsum padma rā ga dang padma'i rtsa ba thags su btags pa lta bu re/ skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad du snyan brgyud zab mo'i be'u bum po ti re dang bcas pa khur/ kho bo cag rkang 'gros kyis bul bas/ rta sngon po brtan brling 'dzoms pa sga srab la sogs pa dkyus thub pa zhig la zhon/ thub pas dbyar gyi ras chen gnang ba dang mthun pa'i char skyob kyi ras nam thang yug po che/ mu men gyi mtha' 'jag btang ba lta bu zhig gyon/ mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel gyi dgon pa nas chas te rang gi bsti gnas su cung zad ngal gsos/ 'dar stod rnam rgyal stag rtse'i pho brang gi mdun sar mchod rten gyi rab gnas dang / dga' ston bsgrubs te rim par chas pa ni 'di ltar ro/ /yid 'ong mtsho chen ngogs su chas pa yi/ /dpal ldan ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab bzang dbang / /ngur pa bye bas bskor ba'i mdzes sdug ni/ /mkha' la li khri'i rdul dmar 'khrigs pa ltar/ /de bzhin bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen la/ /rings par chas pa'i rnal 'byor ku sā li/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i slob 'khor dang bcas pa/ /yul dbus 'dzin ma'i sman ljongs yangs par chas/ /gang de mthong ba'i skal bzang gzhon nu rnams/

/'di skyid phyi ma bde ba'i rnam thar can/ /'di 'dra'i rjes su nga yang khrid na bsam/ /yid kyis re smon ci yang 'debs par byed/ /de'i nub ha cang mi ring ba'i grong khyer don grub gling zhes bya bar skyed tshal ljon shing gi do ra 'khrigs pa zhig 'dug pa der/ lcog grwa rnams sprin dkar gyi phreng ba tshar du dngar ba ltar brgyab/ chos spyod kyi rim pa 'brug gi sgra ltar du ldir/ rgya ja bzang po ngar ngad 'dzoms pa'i btung ba dbyar gyi chu mtsho ltar chal chil du longs spyod cing gnas pa'i tshe/ de'i dgon par chos rje'i drung gis nged dpon slob 'ga' gdan drangs gzhis len shangs len gzabs ma mdzad/ nang so dang sngar 'dris kyi grwa pa rnams kyis kyang ja 'dren sogs legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel thog mar 'grig pa byung / de snga yan char dkon tsam yod pa la/ de rjes nged dpon slob rnams so sor dgongs thun gyi rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par rtsom pa na/ phyogs tha gru nas char sprin dal bus gtibs/ 'brug sgra zab mo'i sgra dbyangs dang bcas pa'i char gyi rgyun chen po babs pas/ 'bru bcud rnams rab tu sos shing skye bo rnams yid dga' bdes 'tsho bar gyur to/ /bhu su ku de lam du chas pa'i tshe/ /de yi gtsug rgyan rje btsun kha'u pa'i/ /thugs rje'i dge mtshan 'od zer stong 'phros pas/ /rgya mtsho'i klu rnams dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ /phyogs kun char sprin gsar pas ched du gtibs/ /sprin rum nang nas 'brug sgra dal gyis rgod/ /glog phreng gzhon nu'i go skabs dbye ba yi/ /yid bzhin spos chu'i char chen deng 'dir babs/ /lo thog rtsi shing nyi gzhon gyis phye ba'i/ /padmo ji bzhin phyogs bcur 'dzum dkar g.yo/ /mi rnams sbrang rtsis myos pa'i bung ba bzhin/ /rab tu dga' ba'i dar dir glu dbyangs len/ /sang nyin snga bar chas nas lcags la zhes bya'i la brgal nas rim par brgyud/

lcags thang gi mda' phyug po shar pa zer ba'i khyim bdag dad pa can zhig gi lcang ra klu sdings shig 'dug par bsdad/ der zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga rje bla ma'i tshes mchod kyi skabs su babs byung bas/ bla ma mchod chog rgyas par byas sbyin bdag des kyang bsnyen bkur 'bul ba sogs yang dag byung / sang tsha ba'i steng du/ bla ma zhang dgon pa ba'i sgrub gnas/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i gsung ngag rin po che gsan pa'i yul sa thang ding zhes bya bar slebs/ de'i gtsug lag khang mchod rten chos khri dang bcas pa mjal/ phyag mchod smon lam gsol gdab byas te/ dpal jo mo nang gi ri khrod chen por slebs/ de'i nub sku 'bum thang du lcog grwa byas bsdad pas/ der gnas mjal la 'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi skya ser pho mo mang po 'dug pa rnams kyis/ nged dpon slob la ltad mo dag snang bskor ba chos 'brel zhu ba sogs mang po byung / sang snga dro sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo/ sbyor drug brgyud pa'i lha khang sogs mjal/ ri khrod la rgyang bltas byas pas blo 'gro zhing yid 'phrog pa/ sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis 'di lta bu'i gnas su sgrub grwa'i rgyun btsugs/ skye bo mang po thar pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa ches cher ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar du 'dug kho bo cag kyang 'di lta bu'i dben gnas shig tu byang chub sgrub pa zhig nam 'ong snyam pa snying gi dkyil du lhang lhang ba'i dag snang byung ngo / /e ma nags rgyal sman btsun dbang mo'i ri/ /ri ngos tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i nags kyi khrod/ /khrod yangs rdo ba'i spyil chung skyid pa'i nang / /nang der byang chub sgrub pa'i skal bzang tsho/ /mthong ba'i mod la yid ni za zir gyur/ /bdag kyang nam zhig 'di 'dra'i skal bzang zhig /cis kyang bsgrub snyam snying gi gseb phrag tu/ /'gyur med dam bca'i phur pa brtan por thebs/ /de nas mda' skor byas/

brag ram pa chos rje'i mgon khang mjal/ gnod sbyin chen po la snyan dar gsol mchod 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa rgyas par byas/ brag ram slob dpon pas gdan drangs ja 'dren ras dkar gyi phyag rten dang bcas pa phul/ gnod sbyin gyi chos skor zhu ba'i snyan gsan phab/ rjes su de ltar byed pa'i khas blangs/ de dang khad nye ba'i chu mo lung gi dgon pa na grub pa mchog gi dbang po 'khrul zhig ratna bha dra bzhugs pa'i drung du mjal/ de nub tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dbang / de'i tshe dbang bka' sdod ging lnga gza' gdong gi srog dbang bka' gtad dang bcas pa zhus/ sang 'gro khar nged dpon slob thams cad kyis lhan cig tu/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhus/ de'i tshe rje bla ma 'khrul zhig gi spyod pas hūm̐ ring hūm̐ thung gi gdangs dbyangs gar stabs nged kyi grwa pa rnams la bka' bkyon dang thugs 'dogs spel ba'i hur spyod mang po mdzad kyi 'dug pas/ khong tsho thams cad dad pa skyes/ 'jig rten chos brgyad med pa'i bla ma zer na 'di 'dra zhig yong ba yin zer bzhin gda'/ bla lung ri bo'i spo la 'khrul zhig rje/ /kun bzang dgongs pa'i bcud kyis myos pa des/ /gar dgu'i rol rtsed hūm̐ sgra sgrog pa'i tshe/ /skal ldan snying la 'dod 'jo'i bka' drin sbyin/ /de nas bo dong phun tshogs rab brtan gyi pho brang na rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang po kun dga'i mtshan can bzhugs pa'i zhabs drung du mjal/ ngos kyi dpal kyai rdo rje'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus/ nged dpon slob thams cad thun mong du gser g.yabs zer ba'i 'khyams grwa zhig 'dug pa der phebs/ gdan khri shin tu mtho ba la bzhugs nas sku'i gzi brjid nyi zla zil gyis gnon nus pa tsam/

gsung gi gdangs 'brug ltar ldir bzhin pas rol mo bzang po 'khrol ba dang bcas tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bka' drin bskyangs/ kho bo rang gis sngar phul ba'i dbang dril shing khul mas gtso byas zang zing gi gnang sbyin bzang po'ang gnang / nged rang ni rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po chos dbyings su gshegs rjes rje 'di nyid bla ma'i gtso bo yin zhing / rdo rje 'chang dngos kyi 'du shes yod pas dad pa dang spro ba cig car byung / grwa pa rnams ni ha cang mjal dka' zhing gzi brjid che ba tsam 'dug nged rang grwa pa rnams kyi bla ma chos rje dka' bzhi ba de 'dra ba zhig yong ba yin zer ba la/ nged kyis de 'dra ma zer rje 'di pa deng sang gzur gnas kyis bltas na sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang kun gyi gtso bo/ nged rang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ khyad par nged rang gi bla ma'i gtso bo rdo rje 'chang dngos dang zhal mi gnyis pa zhig thag chod pas so sor snying nas gsol ba thob/ byin rlabs khyad par can 'jug nges pa'i khag 'khur ba yin/ 'phral che khyad che ba tsam rje la chos brgyad kyi rtog pa ci mnga'/ sbyin bdag stobs ldan gyi zhabs tog la dmigs pa yin mod byas/ de mthun gnas gsar nas nabs so zhal ngo rnams kyis kyang bsnyen bkur shangs len yang dag mdzad do/ /rnam rgyal rab brtan rgyal po'i pho brang na/ /chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan/ /'jigs med seng ge'i khri la 'gyings bzhin du/ /nges don zab mo'i ngang las ma g.yos pa'i/ /zhal bzang ston gyi zla shel lta bu mthong / /zhabs kyi padma gtsug gi rgyan du blangs/ /gsung ngag bdud rtsis snying la bde ba thob/ /kwa ye grogs dag chu gter kha dog la/ /ma 'jigs dad pa'i gzings su zhugs shig dang / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i ded dpon bka' drin gyis/ /dngos grub nor bu thob par the tshom med/

/sa steng 'di na rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin yongs kyi ral pa'i zur phud la/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i zhabs sen ngal gso ba'i/ /kho bo'i gtsug rgyan sngags 'chang 'di 'dra dkon/ /de nas rdzi lung du zhag gcig bsdad/ sang nyin dge sdings na dpal sa skya'i chos kyis mngon par mtho ba'i khri la bzhugs pa/ bdag chen rin po che khri thog pa'i drung bzhugs pa dang mjal/ de snga nas dpon slob 'dris pa lta bu'i nang gtsang zhing thugs 'gol bas/ bka' lung bag phebs par gnang / nged rnams la bdag chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod chog rgyas bsdus kyi lung / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'dod zhus ltar bka' drin bskyangs/ sku na phra mo de lta bu la 'di 'dra'i lugs gnyis kyi gnang skyong dang ngo mtshar ba 'ong ba nges par 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa la the tshom mi za ba 'dug snyam pa'i dad mos dang / sa skya pa'i rmongs zhen gyis blo bde ba tshad med pa byung / byin rlabs kyi rten gnang sbyin sogs yang dag thugs rjes bzung / de'i nub khro phur phyin/ 'du khang chen po zhig 'dug pa der bsdod sa byas/ nged rang gcig pur zhal ras lha khang gi phyi skor byed cing yod tsa na/ skor lam de na bud med gzhon nu nad pa yin zer ba zhig khyel byas nas 'dug skor ba 'ga' song tsa na de la mche ba je ring je ring yong gi 'dug mig 'khrul ba'am/ krung krum lta bu la bcos nas 'jigs pa ston pa yin nam snyam pa'i tshe/ mthar kha thams cad mche ba skya zang nge ba mtho re lhag pa tsam gyis khengs pa/ dpral ba'i dkyil na khrag gi mig sman tshe lung thang gi rdog po 'dra ba zhig byas/ har de langs byung bas/ 'di srin mo'i 'bal mo lta bu zhig yin pa 'dug snyam/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang bcas pas lag tu phreng ba khur nas ded pas skor lam la bros song / rjes la bcug phyin pas lho phyogs kyi khyim tshang gi nang zhig tu bros nas sgo de nang nas bcad song /

de 'phral 'og tu log gam snyam pa la/ sems theng ba 'dra ba zhig byung nas skor ba gsum tsam byas pas khang pa de'i steng nas bud med de'i mgo 'dra ba zhig skra zing nge ba mthong tsam byas/ skad gdangs ngar che ba'i gdangs ma dbyangs la/ dad mos kyi snang ba mi 'dug kyang / /tshe sngon gyi las 'brel gcod thabs med/ /khrag 'dzag srin po'i ri la 'phrad/ /'phan dkar gyi ljongs su rjes su 'dzin/ /'jigs snang log lta ma byed ang / /bde chen longs spyod rnal 'byor pa/ /zer ba zhig lab byung ba'i mod la sngar gyi 'jigs snang de zhig pa 'dra ba'i rig pa had de chod de ba/ lus ljid med pa 'dra ba'i za zi ban bun/ rdog pa gar rgyab mi shes pa/ snang ba 'di gsal la gtad so med pa skad bton la rgyug gam snyam pa zhig byung bas 'di bar chad dam dngos grub gang yin mi shes pa 'dug da ras nas brda zhig ston pa ma byung / do mngon du ma gyur bar la gsang dgos snyam zla bo rnams la sgros ye ma btang / de'i 'og gi 'du khang nang gi lcog bur bsdad pa'i tshe/ gtor bsngo sogs spros bcas kyi dge sbyor rnams kyang de ga'i ngang du 'gro ba zhig byung / ci yin nam cha med ya mtshan ni che snyam dge sbyor gyi ngang du srel/ der byams chen/ sku 'bum chen mo/ rnam sras rang byon sogs mjal/ phyag mchod smon lam yid ches pa btab/ sang tsha thon la dge sdings nas bdag chen rin po che'i phyag phyi drung 'khor gzhon pa kha cig kyang gnas mjal la byung / nged tshos ja bzang po bskol nas drangs/ dag snang byas thams cad bsdongs nas zhal ras lha khang mjal/ de na phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sku li ma zhig 'dug pa de'i phag zhal dang thog gi bar la shel gyi 'khar ba btsugs pa lta bu zhig 'dug pas/ 'di gang yin byas lag pa reg pas 'od ma gtogs reg rgyu min 'dug dkon gnyer de na re/ de phag zhal yin pa gda' zer/ de khong rnams kyis ma mthong ba 'dug pas kha rog bsdad/

sku de la mgo gtugs te dbang bzhi blangs smon lam btab bo/ /lar rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo 'di/ nged rang la thog ma nas dgyes pa zhig yin 'dug pas rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po'i gsung nas kyang / chos rje la mkha' spyod byin rlabs byas res kyi nged la ltas khyad par can re yong gi 'dug 'bad rtsol mdzad na 'dis mkha' spyod la 'khrid nyen gda'o gsung ba yod cing / 'di skor gyi gtam mang po zhig yod de/ snod mi 'dug pas nam mkha'i dbyings su phaṭa/ sprang rgyal khams phyogs med rgyu ba'i tshe/ /yul ya mtshan gyi ltad mo 'di ltar mthong / /shab dge sdings rdo rje'i pho brang na/ /rje sa skya lo tsā'i sku yi dbon/ /thugs gcig tu 'dres pa sras kyi mchog /khong 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu dngos dang mjal/ /gsung bag phebs kyi bdud rtsi snying la sim/ /chos zab lam rnal 'byor bka' drin zhus/ /khong skyon bral gyi mdzad phrin mthong ba'i tshe/ /nged sa skya pa'i 'dun ma 'grub 'dug snyam/ /sems dga' spro dang dad pas mchi ma 'khrug /zhabs spyi gtsug tu blangs nas smon lam btab/ /der shab stod kyi chu klung brgal nas phyin/ /yul ya mtshan can khro phu'i gtsug lag slebs/ /lha byams mgon gyi sku brnyan zhal bzang mthong / /rten khyad par can kun la byin rlabs zhus/ /ma mi min mkha' 'gros 'jigs gzugs bstan/ /nga khro rgyal gyi nga rgyal dbyings nas rgyas/ /mtshon 'phreng lcag gis 'ded drag btang ba'i tshe/ /khong lung bstan gyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa skad/ /khyod ye shes kyi ḍā ki'i lung bstan dang / /mo sha zan gyi mkha' 'gro'i rgyang 'bod gnyis/ /nga rnal 'byor gyi sems la bde sdug med/ /gang yin yang rang ngo dbyings su snyam/ /a la la rgyal khams skor ba'i tshe/ /sngon med kyi ltad mo a re 'jigs/ /sems nyid kyi rang mdangs yin par go /drin can gyi bla ma de sku drin che/ /dpal mkha' spyod kyi dga' ma yid 'ong ma/

/dus ring nas bskyangs pa'i ma ma des/ /da rig 'dzin grub pa ster ba'i brda'/ /yongs ngo mtshar gyi zlos gar ci yang rtse/ /de nas gnas kyi mda' na dam pa dmar po'i rus yin zer ba zhig gi lag na dam pa'i gdung rus las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dang sras kyi thugs rang byon yin zer ba sogs 'dug pa mjal/ de'i nub gangs can chos 'phel gyi dgon pa'i 'khris/ lha mo dmag zor ma'i bla mtsho yin zer ba mtha' ljon pa'i tshal gyis bskor ba'i dbus na ne'u gseng gi dkyil na mtsho chung 'khor sa zhig 'dug pa'i kha stod skyid skyid 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa der lcog grwa byas bsdad/ ja bzang bskol zhing chos spyod byas pas grwa pa rnams byon byung nas/ 'di pa cha lugs sogs rtogs ldan du mi 'dug grwa mthun la skyid mdog rnam pa sgo yangs pa zhig 'dug pas sde pa zil gnon pa lta bu zhig brdzus pa yin nam zer/ gcig na re nga dang zhal 'dris yod/ sde pa zil gnon pa yin thag chod 'dug zer bas phal cher de la yid ches so/ /su yin zer ba la/ nga ci med kyi sprang po yan pa blo bde bya ba yin no ang byas pas/ khyed rang su yin yang nyams dga' la snang ba bde ba zhig 'dug zer ro/ /thag khrar sbrul du 'khrul ba'i snang ngo na/ /'jigs skrag 'bros la thug pa don byed nus/ /yid ches mos gus ldan pa'i gang zag la/ /khyi so ring bsrel phung por song ngo skad/ /ming tsam brda tsam btags pa kho na la'ang / /rang rang ngo bos grub pa rdul tsam med/ /ci med cir yang 'char ba'i ngo mtshar can/ /rten 'brel zab mo'i rang mtshang de ru rig /skye bos bzhi mdor smra ba'i khungs med gtam/ /gang zer bden par 'dzin pa'i blo chung tshos/ /gzhi med ri bong cal gyi sgra dbyangs kyis/ /rang gzhan mang po'i rang mtshang ston nyen gda'/ /stag la skya mo dung gi sgo brgal te/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas gtsang chu mig ring mor slebs/

de nub gnas 'brel byas/ sngon zangs dkar lo tsā bas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang / snyan sgrol/ 'phags pa rin po che'i sku 'dra sogs bzhugs pa'i lha khang / bdag chen rin po che grags blo bas bzhengs pa'i mgon khang sogs mjal/ gsol gdab smon lam yid ches par byas/ de dag la ngo mtshar zhing byin rlabs kyi zil gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug pas dad mos tshad med pa skyes/ deng sang zhabs tog bdag rkyen cher med pa'i gog nyams chen po 'dug pa la sems kyis mi bzod pa'i skyo snang yang yod pa zhig byung / sang nyin nyi ma phyed yol tsam na ngor e wam̐ chos ldan du slebs/ mdzo mo rwa ba yod pa'i spang steng der lcog sgar byas bsdad/ lam zab lha khang du bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa zhig blangs/ spyi sgos kyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam btab/ gzhan yang lam 'bras lha khang gis gtso byas pa'i rten gsum rnams kyang mjal/ dbon po rin chen seng ge bas gzhis len skabs babs byas/ khrom thog dbon po sogs 'dod chos dgos zer ba mang dag byung bas/ thog gcig la gur mgon gyi rjes gnang byas/ 'phral mkho'i ja gos dar sogs 'bul ba'ang 'ga' byung / de nas zhwa lu la chas te phyin pa'i lam bar nas lcags stod mthong byung bas/ nged tsho sa skya pa'i yus po che'i mi gsum gyi nang nas/ shar smad tsong kha'i dge bshes rin chen brtson 'grus kyi brgyud pa/ dpon chen dbon shrī rgyal ba bzang po dang / hu shrī rgod po rin chen sogs rim par brgyud pa'i pha tshan shin tu nye ba zhig yin pas/ khong tsho dar rgud dang bde dog gang 'dra zhig yod dam snyam/ dgos med 'jig rten gyi rmongs zhen zhig skyes/ zhu rag gi bsam pa med kyang bya bral gyi gnas skabs sems la gang shar lag tu blangs chog snyam pas der phyin/ khong tsho'i gzhis ka'i stod der lcog grwa byas/ ngas lcog bur bsdad/ khong grwa pa rnams nyams dga' dga' dang sbrags pas bsngo ba smon lam brgyabs pas mang ja nyung ja gdan snon dang bcas pa bskyal song /

su yin zer ba la nged rnams la stod mthon po nas yin zer ba byas na'ang / rjes su ngor pa'i grwa ba 'ga' sogs rim par brgyud nas cha tsam ngo shes 'dug pas/ dpon 'og ma 'dra ba'i mi gzhon zhig nga'i rtsar byung / 'di 'dra yin pa 'dra zer ba'i rtsad gcod zhib mo byed kyin 'dug pas da ci nas nged bya bral du song bas skyug bro byas dogs spam me bsdad pa yin/ ngo bo de ltar yin pas mjal 'phrad tsam mdzad 'dod yod na de ga bgyis pas chog byas pas kho log song / re zhig nas slebs nas deng sang sku mtshams dam me ba zhig yod pas mjal stabs ma bde byung / sang nyin cis kyang bzhugs pa gnang dgos zer ba la/ mjal bzhed med pa thugs dang bstun pas chog pa 'dug nged tsho rgyal khams la rings po sdod pa'i long med byas/ don la rang gi rigs rus dang pha tshan sogs gang yin gyi blang dor med pa'am/ yang na mi sngun du ngo 'degs mi thub pa zhig yod pa yin yong / nga la shākya thub pa'i bka' drin gyis phyogs gang la phyin yang bsnyen bkur byed mkhan ni thogs med 'ong gi 'dug 'di skor gyi zhen thag de chod pas blo bde/ lar btsun pa gnyen sred ches pa la de 'dra mang po 'byon/ khyod snying tshim tshim snyam pa byas/ nam zi la langs phyin/ nged tsho'i rjes la chas ka phran bu dang bcas lam sna ba yin zer ba zhig btang byung / mi dgos log rgyug byas kyang mi nyan par zhwa lu bar phyin/ de nub rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang gi mgon khang mjal bas der gtor ma'i 'khris su bud med gos dkar khra gyon pa zhig byung ba de mthar phyi nang gang du song cha med pa la yal ba lta bu zhig byung / zhwa lu gnas kyi gser khang gi thugs rje chen pos gtso byas steng shod kyi lha khang mgon khang rnams zhib par mjal/ gzhal yas khang gi mdo der drung chen bya ba yin zer ba'i gyod rgan bkar brgyud pa la rgyab rten bcol ba/

dom da ra dang slel bem gyi sgrib shing gyon pa zhig dang / drung rgyal ba zer ba'i ban gzhon mig ltag pa na yod pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug pas/ khong tshos ja 'dren gzhis len byas/ kho rang tsho dang blo bstun pa'i cha le cho le mang po lab btang bas shin tu dga' song / de na jo las pa bya ba 'grul pa thams cad la za 'dod byed pa zhig 'dug pas/ slong mo dgos zer byung bas/ nged rang rnams sprang po ni mnyam por 'dug khyed tsho zhwa lu ba yin snyam pa yod na'ang / nged tsho 'dar pa yin sprad chog byas pas thams cad bzhad gad theg ge ba byung nas za 'dod cher ma byas/ de nub ri phug tu phyin/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos khri'i mdun der lcog grwa byas bsdad/ nā land+ra'i bco brgyad pa'i 'tsho byed gcig yod pa des gzhis len bsnyen bkur zur chas sogs zhabs tog yang dag byas/ sang de ri phug bla brang na bzhugs pa'i bu ston rin po che'i sku 'dra phyag nas mas gtso byas pa'i rten gsum shar chen gyi rten sogs zhib par mjal/ mkhyen rab rin po che'i zhal slob bgres po zhig 'dug pa la phyag rdor 'gro bzang gi dbang / rnam sras zhi drag gi rjes gnang / rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bka' gtad/ yig lung dang bcas pa zhus/ de nub rdzing bur brag sgo ba zer ba'i khams pa phyug po zhig gis gdan drangs der phyin/ tshe dbang rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang sogs byas/ ja bzang po zhig phul byung bas lam ja la shin tu mkho ba byung / zhen med kyi nye du'i sgo bsnyegs pas/ /dgos med kyi lam stobs de ru bcag /don med kyi lung sbug bskor ba'i 'bras/ /'brel med kyi sa mtshams de ru bris/ /spyir sems can kun drin can pha mar 'dug /sgos su byams gnyen la gang skyid yul/ /nga bya bral gyi 'dun ma yang rtser yod/ /khyed pha tshan sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /dpal zhwa lu gser bkang gi dgon pa na/ /ban smyon kun gri ring shal 'dzugs byed/

/mi bsad la ya 'ud mi gda' bas/ /sprang po ngas ri sbug dgon par bros/ /sngar 'dris kyi slob mas zhabs tog bzang / /ku su lu'i bla ma lam du mjal/ /gang zhus kyi chos 'brel lhug par gnang / /khong bka' drin mi chung che bar 'khums/ /lar da lta gangs ri'i ljongs 'di na/ /dgon spyi chos kyi rang tshugs 'dzin pa la/ /khong 'gran zla bral ba'i zhwa lu ba/ /bod chos sde tsho'i srog shing dam pa lags/ /khong brag sgo ba bya ba'i phyug po de/ /mig rgya khab las phra ba zhig yin zer na'ang / /nga bya bral la lam ja bzang po phul/ /dus gzhan gyi ja sigs gcig las dga'/ /khos khengs drags kyis brnyas pa yin las che/ /yul rgyan gong gi lha mo de gnod kyi 'dug /ngas gtor ma dang bka' bsgo drag po byas/ /de re zhig log nas bde bar byung / /de nas thar pa dgon par slebs/ de nub bsdad nas steng shod kyi lha khang mgon khang rnams zhib par mjal/ sang tsha thog tu sman lung du phyin/ bla brang ba de pa dang gnyen tshan rnying pa zhig tu 'gro bas ngo shes byas/ gzhis len yang dag byung / nā ro'i rgyan drug kha che paṇa chen gyi sku chos sogs kyi byin rlabs zhus/ gtsang khang gi rten gsum/ smṛ ti'i gdung 'bum sogs mjal/ stag zhon mgon khang du gtor gsos snyan dar phrin bcol yid ches par byas/ de nas pa rnam gzhung la phyin/ grong stod du zhag sdod byas/ sang nyin snga bar phyin lhun grub rtser slebs/ ngas gnas tshang zhig tu bsdad/ zla bo rnams gzims khang sogs kyi ltad mo dang / zhar la bsod snyoms kyang byed/ sde dpon chos la dkar po zhig yod pa 'dug zer nas song / khong rnams kyis nyi phyed bar bsgugs pas lan tsam yang ma khugs/ nged rang rnams kyi tsha thebs kyang chag pa zhig byung nas log byung / lar gnangs chung la blo rig rgod pa'i sde dpon dpon skya'i rigs 'di/ lug thug gi sgro bas wa mo'i nyin thebs gcog pa ma gtogs dgos pa mi 'dug pas de 'dra'i rigs la bya bral rnams lam gzhung srong ba rang gnad du gda'/

de nas bsam sdings dgon par slebs nas de nub gnas 'brel byas bsdad/ sang nyin de'i ni gu rgyud pa'i pho khrom mgon khang / yang dgon gyi lha khang mgon khang sogs mjal/ chos rje'i drung du nged dpon slob rnams kyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel zhus/ sger gyi mgon dkar gyi rjes gnang zhus pas ma gnang bar/ rtsis kyi mgon po lha chen dpal 'bar gyi rjes gnang bka' drin bskyangs/ de nas rtsis gnas gsar gyi lha khang mgon khang rnams mjal/ sde pa bsod nams rab brtan pas gzhis len shangs len sogs yang dag mdzad/ der 'dol chung na tsha mo zhig yod pa des 'bod du rta pa gnyis rkang tshugs btang byung nas cis kyang yong dgos pa'i nan tan byed kyi 'dug pas khong byings po der bzhag nged dpon slob 'gas skor tsam phyin pas gnas tshul nges par byung ba lags so/ /thar dgon sman lung 'phrul gyi lha khang mjal/ /pha mes brgyud pas bsten pa'i mgon gnyen de/ /snyan dar ba liṃ rgya mtshos mchod byas te/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las bka' bsgo byas/ /de nas pa rnam rdzong gi gzhung du phyin/ /'khor rnams gtor tshogs med pa'i rnga gshang gi /sgra dbyangs snyeg pa'i bya rog bzhin du 'gyod/ /kho bo pho tshod che ba'i khrom thog chod/ /phyin chad phyogs 'dir 'ong ba'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /'di 'dra'i rigs la rim pa ltar 'dzems mdzod/ /zer ba'i rgyang glu len zhing bsam sdings kyi/ /ri la 'dzegs pas lugs gnyis 'dod pa tshim/ /yang smras pa/ nyang stod kyi a mo 'dol chung na/ /tsha mo zhig yod pas nan gyis bos/ /rngan chen dang gzhis len bsres se ba/ khram ngus kyi kha rgyan bcas pa byung / /gter sbyin 'dra yong snyam yod tshod gda'/ /nga rgyal khams kyi longs spyod char ltar babs/ /chos ldan gyi 'gro sa tshags las mang / /dpon ngan gyi khral 'bab yong don med/ /tshon po la snum bkus ma re mdzod/

/de nas bod kyi lha btsan po'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa skya bo byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa lhur len pa/ 'brong rtse nas khri nam mkha' bsod nams kyi drung bzhugs pa'i gzhis ka rnam sras mthong smon dang khad nye ba zhig tu slebs/ su yin rtsad gcod gnang mi byung bas/ dpal ldan sa skya skor nas yin zer ba'i brdzus se ba zhus kyang dgongs nas cis kyang shog gsungs nas phyin/ zhabs tog gzhis len mang dag thugs dkar bas kun nas blangs pa mdzad/ sde pa'i drung padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ bka' sdod rnams kyi srog dbang sogs phul/ gzhan yang 'dod chos kyi thugs bzhed mang po 'dug pa yar lam 'bul ba'i khas len zhus nas rgyal mkhar rtser phyin rdzong rgyab tu lcog grwa byas bsdad pas gnas chen pas cis kyang yong dgos gsungs/ dpal 'khor bde chen gyi shag tu bos gzhis len mdzad/ nang sos sne sbyor mdzad nas chos sde'i lha khang steng shod/ mchod rten chen po/ rgyal rtse'i li ma lha khang gzim chung steng shod 'ga'i rten rnams zhib par mjal/ rgyal rtse nas sde pa chen mo de nyin re bzhin chos sde la zhabs skor la bsgrigs bcug phebs pa mthong bas/ deng sang gi a pho hor 'dra'i don spyi yod pa zhig min 'dug na'ang / chos rgyal gyi mdzad spyod skyo sun med par bsgrigs su bcug pa 'di tsam/ rang thog tu babs na'ang nus pa dka' bas nges par chos rgyal du 'dug snyam pa'i dag snang chen po byung / de rjes 'brug pa ngag dbang chos rgyal dang de gong nas gsung chos kyi 'brel pa yod pas mjal ba dang rwa lung bskor ba sbrags mkha' ro nas yar 'brog gi nang la zhugs/ do ri sogs gnas mjal rim par byed 'dod yod na'ang / grwa pa rnams kyang mgyogs skor la dga' ba tsam 'dug cing / nged rang gi rkang tshab kyi rta de'ang babs kyi rnam pa yod pa zhig byung ba sogs phyogs du ma nas mdor bstan pas 'phred la bcad de rong chung la 'gro ba'i gros thag bcad do/

/bod rgyal po gzhon nus gtsug gis mchod/ /shar rgyal po'i mdzad pas yid rab phrogs/ /rta mdo phrug gi bang 'gros de ru zad/ /khong grwa pa kun za thag nye la dga'/ /dpal rwa lung gi ri khrod lta ba dang / /pha ngag dbang chos rgyal mjal snyam tshe/ /lus 'khos med kyi rkang pas rang mtshang bstan/ /nga lugs gnyis kyi blang dor mi zhan yang / /lus rkang pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis dang len bral/ /khong dud 'gro la 'gro 'dug gi skyabs gnas 'chol/ /nga mi phyed du 'dug snyam snying khong grang / /da yang zhig bsam pa 'di ltar shar/ /gnas lugs la lta ba'i mig yod na/ /chu bur gyi khra hrig med kyang chog /ci bsam kun 'grub pa'i blo yod na/ /sha rus kyi rkang pa med kyang chog /sems nyid kyi yang dgon mthong tsam na/ /rwa lung gi ri ltas de gar gda'/ /dad mos kyis rang zhal mjal tsa na/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma de gar gda'/ /gang byung gis chog na ci byas bde/ /bya btang gi blo sna gang shar yin/ /'gyur med kyi bden grub med pas 'tshengs/ /rong chung la sprang po'i lam sna zug /dpal 'khor bde chen du bsdad pa'i dgongs de/ nged ni gnas chen pa'i mkhar las byed sgang gi nang 'u lag pa dang thug chom gyis khengs pa der nan med byas bsgor bas zhe sun la 'tshig pa za/ zla bo rnams ni de'i nub char lhags 'dres pa zhig gis lcog bu rnams bsgyel/ 'dam bag gi dkyil du nyal dgos pa byung 'dug nged rnams chos sde'i sgor 'dzoms tsa na thams cad phar yus tshur yus su 'dug pas/ ngas kha ma blangs par sngon la thal le phyin/ nyang stod gu la'i phu de na pho rog mdo sde mgon po bya ba'i grub thob gcig gi sku 'dra snyan grags can/ mgon khang dang bcas 'dug pa mjal/ de nub dpon slob thams cad rnam sras mthong smon du 'dzoms/ sang mkhar ba'i mdun man lung dgon pa'i 'khris la byas/ thu ru stag tshal zer ba'i lung nang du zhag gcig bsdad/

sang de snga bar la shin tu che ba zhig brgal phyin pas/ rong sham bhar gyi dgon par tsha ba 'phyi ba la slebs/ sham bhar chos rje'i drung du mjal/ mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi dbang rjes gnang / rong pa'i stag zhon gyi phur dbang du grags pa'i rten mjal bka' bsgo dang bcas pa zhus/ chos skyong de'i chos skor tshang ma dang / zhal bzhi pa'i las mkhan shu tra nag po rnams zhu ba'i rjes su slebs pa'i rgyu mtshan phul/ zhal bzhes kyang phebs so/ /lha snyan shambhar mgul gyi dgon par slebs/ /'khrul zhig bla ma'i zhal bzang mngon du byas/ /pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma nag po de'i/ /sku brnyan mthong zhing dbang dang rjes gnang thob/ /de nub gnas der nyal ba'i 'char sgo la/ /gnyid 'chag thog 'tsheg ba spu zeng nge ba/ /mngon sum rmi lam gang yang ma yin pa'i/ /'og 'gyu'i tshul gyis za zi'i 'char tshul ni/ /gsur dud me dmar 'tshub pa'i lung stong na/ /stag chen smyon pa zhon pa'i mon nag gcig /bstan dgra dam nyams 'tshol zer rgyug cing 'gral/ /stong gsum khu sgras 'gengs shing yod do snyam/ /res 'ga' lings pa khyi khrid mang po yis/ /ri dwags 'ded cing shwa ba'i dmar myog dang / /gzhan yang stag gzig dom dred bya 'ug sogs/ /rgyug 'bral 'phur lding ban bun za zi yis/ /nam langs bar du thub pa'i 'khrul snang byung / /de dag legs par bsam tshe pha rgod rje'i/ /bstan srung mchog 'di mngon sum zhal gzigs nas/ /sgos dgra kha khyer khur nas za ba sogs/ /'jigs su rung ba'i las rjes mngon du bstan/ /de yi rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag yin pas/ /da dung 'di yis dam nyams mang po la/ /drag po'i las sbyor 'grub pa'i ltas su go /de nas sha ra'i gru lcags thon pas de'i gru shan gyi rta mgo'i ngos la/ rin spungs nas sde pa'i bka' shog lcags leb la gzong ris bris pa gser chus byugs pa la/ gru lcags 'di dge rgyun la btsugs pa dang /

mnyan pa la bzhi zur na byin yod pas/ za 'dod kyis gtser ba byung na ngo bsrung med pa'i zhu bas slebs pa gyis/ phyis 'doms pa'i khrims lugs byed zer ba gzer gyis bsdigs nas brgyabs 'dug cing / gnyan pa de rnams kyang snga gong dang mi 'dra ba'i ngo gnong ba byas/ ltogs 'dod cung zad byed 'dod pa'ang gnang sbyin zhu ba yin zer ba las mi 'dug pas/ gzhis ka rin spungs pa khrims dam zer ba'i snyan grags bden par 'dug rgyal po khrims lugs yod pa'i sa phyogs 'di 'dra zhig yong ba yin/ snyom chung lam bde ba/ rdzas ldan blo bde ba sogs bsod nams dpag med 'ong ba 'dug ngo mtshar snyam pas sde pa la'ang dag snang ci yang skyes/ de nub 'bras yul skyed tshal du slebs/ grwa pa rnams shol rags chen po der lcog grwa byas/ sger gyi mkhyen rab chos rje'i dbon/ nged kha'u brag rdzong pa'i grwa rigs kun gyi gtsug rgyan rje brag dkar rab 'byams pa bzhugs pa'i gzim spyil du phyin nas mjal/ dad pa dang dag snang bsam gyis mi khyab pas zhal 'phros 'bel gtam 'ar ma 'ur ma byas skyed tshal ba'i grwa pa sngags chos kyi 'dod zhen che ba mang dag la'ang rjes gnang rig gtad lung sogs mang po byas/ de'i tshe karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje lung par phebs/ sde pa rin spungs pas gdan 'dren zhu rtsis dang / mnga' zhabs kyi skya ser thams cad la zhabs tog dang bsu ba sogs kyis khral brgyabs/ thams cad dga' ba dang skyo ba spel ba'i 'ur ding nge ba 'dug 'bras yul ba dpon slob kyang de ga'i grabs yul khur che ba spro seg ge ba yod 'dug pas/ nged kyi bsam pa la 'bras yul ba'i tshan 'di dpon slob sbyin bdag ma bsten pa'i khral 'bab tsam ni mi byed kha med du 'dug de tsam gyi dwang 'dod rang byed pa'i 'brel med dam snyam pa shar/ ngo shes phrad pa rnams khyed karma pa mjal las che zer/ phral de tsam byed zer ba tsam byas/

don la karma pa rang skyes bu dam pa yin nyen yod mod/ nged rang gi thos tshod la dpag pa'i lhan skyes kyi shar tshod karma pa'i rtsa ba dwags po rin po che'i slob ma'i gtso bo khams pa mi gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan dus gsum mkhyen pa khams pa dbu se zer ba de yin pas/ khong rnams la bab thob byed na/ rgya gar gyi nā ro mai tri sogs kyi gdams pa/ bod yul gyi mar pa mi la sogs nas brgyud pa'i sgrub rgyud bka' babs chu bo'i gzhung lta bu zhig yod pas/ de gtso bor skyong dgos rgyu yin pa la/ dgos pa'i mchod rten nag por bzhag mi dgos brag la dbu dkar gsol ba'i dpe'i rnam pas/ sa skya pa dang dga' ldan pa sogs gang byed la mi sdo bzhin du 'gran pa'i rnam pas/ mtshan nyid dang sgra snyan ngag rgyud 'chad nyan 'di nas 'chad rang cher med pa'i rnam grangs mang la dngos ma gtsang ba myog pa zhig dang / 'jig rten gyi dpon chen dang / dpon chung dang / yang chung sogs chos brgyad gang 'phel gyi bya ba lhur len pa 'dra ba/ khong rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma dang de dag gi gsung rab rnams la chas chod ras su bor re ba/ deng sang karma pa rang gi bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin cung drag pa rnams la'ang smod cing / de dag gi grwa rigs drag pa tshun chad khong rang gi phyag phyir gang khugs byed pa kho na 'dug zer bas/ snying nas dad pa ldang ba ni ma skyes byung / de phyin nged rang sa skya pa'i bza' rkang ma gtogs/ karma pa'i khral 'bab kyi khur ni ci yang med/ deng sang gi mi phal cher gyis byed pa ltar/ sde dpon dpon skya gcig gi bla ma bcol 'dug na cis kyang chos zhu snyam pa dang / mtha' mi mang gis bskor 'dug na sangs rgyas yin snyam rgyug pa'i blun po ni nged rang min/ rang gi dgon chung la mang ja 'gyed bcas yong ngam snyam pa dang / gzhan dgon chung ngam grwa rigs re re tsam 'byor re ba'i ched du chos 'brel zhu ba'i ltogs la me 'bar gyi bla ma slob dpon ni min/

legs legs kyi khral mjal ni byed don mi 'dug lar rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po dang mjal nas gsung ngag rin po che 'di thob man chad/ gzhan bla ma dang gdams ngag gang la'ang byang chub bsgrub pa'i ched du mi smon zhing / 'gram chu mi ldang ba'i nges shes gting tshugs shig yod pas lam gzhung bsrangs phyin/ 'on kyang rje thams cad mkhyen pa karma 'phrin las pa'i zhabs drung du karma pa'i zab chos mang po thob pas/ karma pa sngon ma rnams kyi sku skye yin thag chod na mi btub snyam/ ma dad ma gus pa ye ma byung ba byas/ de yang spyir theg chen gyi gang zag gi sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha mar shes nas dag snang sbyong ba dang / bye brag gsang sngags bla med kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis cir snang thams cad lha dang ye shes kyi rnam rol tu shes par byas nas de dag la dad pa dag snang tshad du bskyal nas so so'i rang zhal rjen par mthong ba'i mod la lhug par skyong ba 'di gnad du yod pas de ga'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag pa lags so/ /rje yongs grags kyi sangs rgyas karma pa/ /bod skye bo kun 'dud pa'i gnas gcig pu/ /khyed bslu med kyi skyes bu los kyang yin/ /khong dad can kun 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol/ /sems log rtog gi sprin gyis ma bsgribs kyang / /khyed mdzad spyod kyi rnam thar 'od dkar gyis/ /nga snying dbus kyi padma bzhad ma nus/ /dus da res rgya lam srong ba zhu/ /khong phal gyis mjal ba stong 'ur yin/ /khong la la dag mjal ba che 'dod yin/ /khong 'ga' zhig mjal ba ltogs 'dod yin/ /khong de 'dra tsho snying nas dad pa min/ /nga skad stong la rgyug pa'i khyi rgan min/ /nga lto phyir du rgyug pa'i sprang rgan min/ /nga zol zog gis 'khor ba'i blun rgan min/ /nga dgon chung gis 'phongs pa'i bla rgan min/ /gnas dpal ldan sa skya'i dben gnas mchog /dpal kha'u brag gi pho brang na/ /rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug rdo rings pa'i/

/thugs gcig tu 'dres pa'i gces phrug yin/ /ma bdag med mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi bcud/ /rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhal gyi rgyun/ /dpal sa skya'i bla chen gdams pa des/ /rgyud yongs su tshims pas gzhan mi smon/ /dus da lta'i sa brdzus kyi bande tsho/ /chos 'di 'dra'i skal bzang ma thos pas/ /sems chos brgyad rtogs 'dod kyi rgyug 'bram gyis/ /yul gar 'gro dang 'dir 'gro med snying re rje/ /rje drin can gyi bla ma rdo rings pa/ /khyed bsam bzhin du bka' drin 'khor thabs med/ /sprang rang mgo thon pa bla ma'i drin/ /de dran pa'i mod la mchi ma dku/ /nga phyogs med kyi dad pa mkha' ltar yangs/ /sgos karma pa la snying nas dad/ /khyod chos brgyad ltogs 'dod don gnyer tsho'i/ /gnas tshul nas smras pa bzod par gsol// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa lam glu dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
